item.title: Instructions for Install Nvidia Drivers Cuda and Cudnn
item.author: Author
item.description: 1. install ubuntu Nvidia drivers ubuntu-drivers devices # display alternaive version of nvidia drivers sudo apt install nvidia-driver-515 or choose to install driver and cuda automatically: sudo ubuntu-drivers autoinstall Note: after reboot, choose enroll key to input your passwd, after this, nvidia-smi would work. enroll mok;continue;yes;input passwd;reboot; 2. install cuda manual, this tutorial is suitable for ubuntu22.04 x86_x64 deb(local) 补充：由于ubuntu22.04需要安装liburcu6软件包，不然cuda安装会少依赖。所以这里需要自己下载并安装 https://ubuntu.pkgs.org/20.04/ubuntu-main-amd64/liburcu6_0.11.1-2_amd64.deb.html sudo dpkg -i xxxxx 2.1 visit the web to obey the instructions provided by nvidia: https://developer.
